name: Kampala
subtitle: Kampala, capital of Uganda: its numbers, a short history and places to see beyond the World Heritage list.

keyPoints.text: The Kampala site was where the Buganda king held his royal court; Lugard's company made it its headquarters in 1890.
Captain Lugard set up a fortified camp at Old Kampala in 1890, without the Kabaka's permission.

parts.text: The Kampala site was where the Buganda king held his royal court; Lugard's company made it its headquarters in 1890.
Captain Lugard set up a fortified camp at Old Kampala in 1890, without the Kabaka's permission.
Mengo, not Kampala, was the official capital of Buganda; the kibuga is the settlement around the Kabaka's palace.
The British moved their administration to Entebbe in 1894; Kampala became national capital again at independence in 1962.
Kampala is credited with over 60 percent of Uganda's GDP and 80 percent of industrial output.

blocks.prompt: About how many people do you think live in Kampala?

parts.text: 1,797,722 in 2024, according to the figures compiled from the national statistics office. Which area is counted matters: Resident population of Kampala Capital City per the UBOS 2024 National Population and Housing Census, as reported by EBSCO.

items.text: Lugard fortifies a camp at Old Kampala.
Uganda Museum founded, first housed at Fort Lugard in Old Kampala.
Nakasero market opens for the settler population.
Independence; Kampala re-established as national capital.
St Balikuddembe (Owino) market built at Nakivubo, about 8.5 acres.
City council tries to sell Nakasero market; vendors protest and the sale is overturned.
